scope: reference-backed nominal rigid-body validation; not Forest D1 specimen calibration

world_frame.y: +phi moves the arm tip initially toward +y

pendulum.name: pendulum_joint
pendulum.zero: pendulum COM vertically above its pivot (upright)
pendulum.positive: from upright, pendulum COM initially moves toward +y when phi = 0

positive_arm_torque_at_upright.rationale: positive arm acceleration moves the pivot toward +y; inertial reaction tips the upright pendulum toward -y, which is negative theta by this contract

small_positive_theta_unforced_near_uprig.rationale: theta = 0 is the unstable upright equilibrium

small_negative_theta_unforced_near_uprig.rationale: mirror of the positive-theta unstable response

simulation_fixture_completion.meaning: simulation-only numerical completion: arm_inertia_kg_m2 is represented as equivalent rotary inertia about the arm joint while the orthogonal arm inertia is chosen consistently with a slender radial carrier; pendulum_inertia_kg_m2 is used about both transverse axes while a tiny positive axial inertia keeps the URDF inertia tensor valid. These values do not claim specimen geometry.
